beside_line values are approximate. The margin is crowded and set on a tighter leading than the body, so several notes begin a line or two above the body line that carries their marker (the y note starts beside lines[21], its marker is on lines[26]; the z note beside lines[25], marker on lines[27]; the a note beside lines[28], marker on lines[29]; the e note beside lines[37], marker on lines[39]). Where a note's first line falls between two body lines I have chosen the nearer baseline; the reconciler should not treat a one-line disagreement here as a substantive diff.

there is no foot citation block, no signature and no catchword: all nine citations fit in the outer margin, and the lower quarter of the leaf is blank. A small hooked pen stroke in dark ink (roughly the shape of a long s or a reversed c, about 6 mm high) stands alone in the blank outer margin at the very foot of the page, well outside the type area, with two small ink specks to its right. It is manuscript or offset, not type, and is not a signature — this is a verso, and the mark is on the outer, not the inner, side. Not recorded as an ornament.
